claim.quote: The impurities in the Ingot #94, $^{232}$Th, $^{226}$Ra and $^{210}$Po radioactivity were $4.6\pm 1.2~\mathrm{\mu Bq/kg}$, $7.9\pm 4.4~\mathrm{\mu Bq/kg}$, and $19\pm 6~\mathrm{\mu Bq/kg}$, which are equivalent to those of the DAMA/LIBRA crystals.

key_value_text.quote: The background rate in the energy region of 2-6 keV , was 2-5 events/d/kg/keV without applying a veto trigger.
key_value_text.value: The background rate in the energy region of 2-6 keV , was 2-5 events/d/kg/keV without applying a veto trigger.

name: Radiopurity of NaI(Tl) crystals for PICOLON dark matter experiment

summary.plain: A second PICOLON crystal made with the same purification (Ingot #94) has thorium, radium and polonium contamination equivalent to the DAMA/LIBRA crystals, and a background of 2-5 events per day per kg per keV between 2 and 6 keV without a veto.
summary.technical: Alpha events selected by pulse-shape discrimination: 232Th 4.6 +- 1.2, 226Ra 7.9 +- 4.4 and 210Po 19 +- 6 uBq/kg; background rate 2-5 events/d/kg/keV in 2-6 keV without a veto trigger.

title: Radiopurity of NaI(Tl) crystals for PICOLON dark matter experiment
why_it_matters: It shows that the Ingot #85 purification result was reproduced.
